feeds.title: EdTech Magazine » California
feeds.description: EdTech: Focus on K-12 explores technology and education issues that IT leaders and educators face when they're evaluating and implementing a solution. CDW is a leading multi-brand technology solutions provider to business, government, education, and healthcare organizations in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada. They provide you with all the necessary information regarding the California education system, policies, exams, events, news, and updates.

feeds.title: UC Riverside

UC Riverside covers unique topics in its blogs as world news, research and developments, technological advancements, university news, events, community news, and updates.

feeds.title: CalMatters » Education
feeds.description: CalMatters is a nonprofit & nonpartisan state newsroom dedicated to explaining how government impacts people's lives. their education section covers California education news and analysis. Updates on California's university system, public schools, charter schools, education policy and more.

feeds.description: The Mercury News shares Bay Area News, Sports, Weather, and Things to Do. In their reduction section, they talk about Coverage of San Francisco Bay Area public schools, school performance, test scores, and California colleges and universities from The Mercury News.

feeds.title: Early Edge California Blog
feeds.description: Early Edge California is aweel recognized statewide advocacy organization advancing quality early ed so children can be happy, healthy, and engaged learners by their first day of school & every day after. Go through their blog and learn more about their functions, the organization's work, children's activities, and more.

feeds.title: Education Beat
feeds.description: A podcast that gets to the heart of schools in California and beyond, bringing you the personal stories behind the headlines, from preschool to college. Join the team at EdSource each week to hear the voices that are too often drowned out in the broader conversation: parents, teachers, and the students themselves.

feeds.title: California School News Report
feeds.description: CASN is an online service that promotes coverage of school events, programs & services to create a pipeline of schools news that's diverse, thorough & accurate.

feeds.title: CSBA Blog
feeds.description: CSBA is the nonprofit education association representing the elected officials who govern public school districts and county offices of education. With a membership of nearly 1,000 educational agencies statewide, CSBA brings together school governing boards, and administrators from districts and county offices of education to advocate for effective policies. Their blog talks about their ongoing activities in CSBA publishes articles helpful for their students and staff, and addresses issues related to education, schools, colleges, students, current events, activities, community, and more.
